newsitem.title: USA: NaPro places $10 mln of convertible notes.
newsitem.headline: NaPro places $10 mln of convertible notes.

text.p: NaPro BioTherapeutics Inc said on Wednesday that it closed a private placement of $10 million of senior convertible notes.

NaPro said it plans to use the proceeds of the private placement for general corporate purposes. The convertible notes will be sold at par, mature in June 2000 and bear interest at a rate of five percent per annum.
Interest on the notes may be paid in common stock or cash at the option of the company, NaPro said.
Initially, the notes are convertible into common stock of the company at a price of $10.00 per share, the company said.

Starting in October of 1997, the notes are convertible into common stock of the company at a discount, ranging from five percent to 10 percent, from the market price of the common stock on a selected date prior to the conversion.
If not converted into common stock, upon maturity in June 2000 the notes would be exchanged for 13.75 percent five-year debentures, the company said.
As part of this transaction, NaPro has issued to the purchasers of the senior convertible notes warrants to purchase an aggregate of 290,000 shares of common stock at $10.00.
Diaz & Altschul Capital LLC was the placement agent in this transaction and the Delta Opportunity Fund Ltd was the lead investor in this transaction.
